title_en: Technology and Engineering (18/20): Testing an Ergonomic Keyboard
note_en: 经过 can mean "to go through, to undergo," and it often introduces a process that leads to a result: 这款键盘的弧度经过特别设计 "the curve of this keyboard has been specially designed," 经过几次修改 "after several rounds of revisions." English usually turns this into a passive ("has been designed") or uses "after," while Chinese treats the process as something the subject goes through.
